source_support_for.scope: Only the seven scalar/source-flag subset and declared ground-count algebra; no broader design or engine qualification.

corrections.display_summary: H I is parenthesized as well as He II; frozen policy emphasized only He II theory verification. Preserve the H I theory flag explicitly in integrated metadata.

NIST supplied ionization uncertainty is not certified one-sigma, standard uncertainty or Gaussian by the checked GSIE help. Leave these meanings null; do not borrow CODATA standard uncertainty meaning.
H–Ds I query contains108 neutral-element rows. Only the H/He rows were reviewed; this is not an H-only or comprehensive atomic-data read.
CODATA concise parentheses (28) encode last digits of standard uncertainty; they are distinct from ASD parentheses enclosing an energy as a theory flag.

ASD query citation version5.12(2024) differs from HeI levels dataset prepared for5.11(October2023) and HeII dataset for5.10(September2022). The HeII level note mentions CODATA2018. Do not claim all seven values share a fresh2022 joint atomic adjustment.
Scalar source support and convention algebra do not certify LTE, kinetics, full source-derived Saha history or older engine asset independence.
Engine source literals use long double declarations in the snapshot; this does not certify an actual binary64 rounding rule or bit pattern.

Hirata Eq24 primary acquisition failed default TLS due weak certificate; no bypass. That equation and the Sales2023 linked derivation were not checked; no source certification is attached to those docs citations.

limitations: Previously independently accepted original H1/B2 serialization source pins are unavailable. This is a new bounded source-owned proposal, not a reconstruction or certification of those missing contracts.

No joint covariance among these scalar entries was established by the checked sources. Repeated ASD query rows and CODATA page/PDF are duplicate representations, not independent data. Do not assume independence or form quadrature noise.
